scope: Actual local Linux Docker inference in the Railway-compatible backend image. This does not measure hosted Railway latency or capacity.
inputs: The basketball player is sidelined by an ankle injury.
The athlete cannot play because he hurt his ankle.
A film opened at the box office.

observations.normalization_check: embedPublicTexts validates each vector is finite and abs(sum(v_i squared) - 1) < 0.01 before returning it. Exact individual norms were not printed or retained.

reproduction.probe: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {readdir,stat} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {join} from 'node:path'; import {embedPublicTexts,cosineSimilarity,embeddingStatus,EMBEDDING_MODEL} from './lib/workspace/semantic.mjs'; const started=performance.now(); const vectors=await embedPublicTexts(['The basketball player is sidelined by an ankle injury.','The athlete cannot play because he hurt his ankle.','A film opened at the box office.']); const related=cosineSimilarity(vectors[0],vectors[1]),unrelated=cosineSimilarity(vectors[0],vectors[2]); assert.equal(vectors.length,3); assert.ok(vectors.every(v=>v.length===384)); assert.ok(related>unrelated+.15); async function measure(path){let count=0,bytes=0;for(const row of await readdir(path,{withFileTypes:true})){const file=join(path,row.name);if(row.isDirectory()){const part=await measure(file);count+=part.count;bytes+=part.bytes;}else{count++;bytes+=(await stat(file)).size;}}return {count,bytes};} console.log(JSON.stringify({uid:process.getuid(),model:EMBEDDING_MODEL,status:embeddingStatus().status,dimensions:vectors.map(v=>v.length),related,unrelated,milliseconds:performance.now()-started,rss:process.memoryUsage().rss,cache:await measure(process.env.SEMANTIC_MODEL_CACHE_DIR)}));

interpretation: The image can load native ONNX runtime and execute the pinned embedding model despite disabled npm install scripts. Timing includes a fresh public model download and three-text inference. RSS is total process memory, not incremental model memory. No runtime dependency fix was needed.
